note: Hand-curated corrections to the automatic vulnerable/fixed pair, applied by scripts/resolve_fix_pairs.py. Each entry is a case where both independent reviewers (data/fix_review.json) agreed the resolver's pair was wrong and named the right commits, and the git facts were re-checked by hand. vulnerable_commit null means the fix commit's first parent. Confirm in BUILD_PLAN 2.3.

GHSA-2f96-g7mh-g2hx.reason: fixed by the first two commits of PR #2168 (2ab05169 adds prefix-aware option matching, 181e8ede refines it); the advisory links the third, 56806080, which fixes the separate joined-short-option bypass GHSA-v396-v7q4-x2qj. Both reviewers put the pre-fix commit at b920dcd4 and suggested b920dcd4 -> 56806080; ending at 181e8ede keeps this pair disjoint from GHSA-v396's 181e8ede -> 56806080
